recipes.name: Massaman Curry
instructions: Add the ghee (or other cooking oil of choice) to a pot or deep pan over medium heat. Add the Massaman curry paste to bloom for a minute or two. Then add the ginger and Thai chili if using. Continue cooking the mixture for 2-4 minutes, stirring frequently, until fragrant and slightly darker in color. If the mixture starts sticking aggressively or darkening too quickly, lower the heat slightly.

Pour in the coconut milk and stir until the curry paste fully dissolves into the liquid. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer. Full fat coconut milk (or cream) creates the richest, most stew-like texture. You can thin the curry later with water or stock if needed.
Evenly sprinkle the cubed chicken breast with salt to season. Add it to the pan, and bring it back to a simmer. Cook for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Add the potatoes, onion, and sweet potato if using. Simmer gently for 20-30 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the curry slightly thickens. Different vegetables cook at different speeds. Sweet potatoes often soften faster than Yukon Gold potatoes, so you can remove them early and add them back later if needed.

Taste the curry and begin adjusting the flavor balance. Start with fish sauce for salty and umami flavors, then add sugar for sweetness, followed by lime juice for acidity. Keep tasting and adjusting until the curry tastes balanced to you. Serve with cooked jasmine rice and peanuts, which can be added directly to the bowl for crunch or stirred into the curry for a softer texture.
